people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
translations.bsb: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
translations.kjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
translations.asv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: and they gave no portion unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for their cattle and for their substance.
